description: This file defines the class Vtiger_MailScannerAction which manages actions for email scanning in the vtiger CRM, including creating tickets, linking emails to contacts or accounts, and handling email attachments.

classes.name: Vtiger_MailScannerAction
classes.description: Class for managing email scanner actions such as creating tickets, linking emails, and managing attachments within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message if debugging is enabled.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the action with a given action ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the object properties based on database query for the given action ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or creates a mail scanner action record in the database with specified parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the action record from the database.

methods.name: __nextsequence
methods.description: Computes the next sequence number for ordering actions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Executes the configured action on a mail record, such as creating or linking tickets.

methods.name: __UpdateTicket
methods.description: Updates an existing ticket based on email content and regex match information.

methods.name: __CreateTicket
methods.description: Creates a new help desk ticket based on email content.

methods.name: __LinkToRecord
methods.description: Links an email to a contact or account record based on lookup mode.

methods.name: __CreateNewEmail
methods.description: Creates a new email record in CRM and links it to a target record.

methods.name: __SaveAttachements
methods.description: Saves email attachments to the filesystem and links them to CRM records.

methods.name: __SaveAttachmentFile
methods.description: Saves an attachment content to a file on disk and records it in the database.
